title: I was hoping for good results with this one
text: I was hoping for good results with this one. As a long time user of the regular Bialetti pot, I was hoping for good results with this one.  On the induction cook tops it just doesn't perform as it should. about 20% of the water does not pass through the coffee and ends up sitting in the bottom of the pot.  I tried 5 different kinds of coffee, with different grind levels, I got the same result.  The coffee is more intense which I'm OK with but I only get two cups (Espresso size) as oppose to the three you're supposed get. Not really happy.  The regular pot  I have works just fine.  I don't know why Bialetti made an induction pot if the standard aluminum pot works fine.
